page.overview:
Who is Clair Dowar?

Member of parliament and Councillor of the courtroom

The Right Honourable Clair Dowar MP is the Home Secretary of the United Kingdom. A minor character portrayed by British actress, Helen McCrory, she appeared in the 2012 James Bond film, Skyfall. She is very persistent and opinionated. As Home Secretary, her main importance, was to get rid of M as soon as possible during the inquiry, but is interrupted by her colleague Mallory, who allows M to speak on the incident, until Raoul Silva makes his appearance in the courtroom.

Clair Dowar was the minister when M was tried about retirement plans; she was consistently negative about M's actions during the recent MI6 security crisis involving the terrorist attack on the SIS Building, but was by no means willing to deny M a say in the proceedings, as she allowed her to give her own opinions after being prompted by Mallory and seemed intrigued by M's speech on how dangerous their enemies had become. Dowar was present when Raoul Silva attempted to execute M in the courtroom. Upon seeing Silva and his two cohorts armed with Glock 17 pistols, she demonstrated quick reflexes for a politician and dived behind the head desk for cover. When Bond used the fire extinguishers to create a smokescreen, she managed to escape the courthouse thanks to the efforts of Eve Moneypenny, escaping the firefight unharmed.
